actions.name: READ_CUSTOMER_MARGIN
actions.sideEffect: Authenticated GET only. SELECT only for ERP, cost evidence, report and frozen snapshots. No DDL, SP, UPDATE, INSERT, DELETE, cache refresh or financial confirmation. Preserve existing report calc and customer price fields. Keep EstQuantity/EstUnit separate from physical OutQuantity/OutUnit. All products, signed adjustments, source coverage and missing costs remain explicit.

crossYearFixture.description: Same ProdKey, CustKey and OrderWeek in 2025 and 2026 cannot mix. Each comparison period is explicitly year-scoped; previous-year period is chosen from actual calendar, never an unconditional week52.
